posts.text: “Hi. It’s Wednesday. Now please listen to me closely. This hot. No hotter. This is the weather all the doggies want until the leaves turn brown. There are a couple huskies and St Bernards who would like it colder. But nobody wants it hotter. No the shepherds, not the poodles, not even those hairless guys. This is just right. You can’t say you weren’t told. Also, I love you.”

lol
